live_audio_read_back: se_slot[16] / status_se_slot[4] / voice_slot[2]: is_playing, is_playing_status, is_playing_voice and get_se_vol / get_se_vol_db query the playing sound objects; scripts that branch on them read audio state
simulation_vs_presentation.note: No SoundModule field feeds physics, hitboxes or status. A port without audio can stub everything except the script-set values above (keep them as plain storage so the getters return what scripts set) and give deterministic answers for the is_playing* family (e.g. false), which are the only reads of live audio state.

notes: Base constructor f_71004cba30 builds 22 sound slots (16 x 0x50 SE, 4 x 0x50 status SE, 2 x 0x48 voice) after an 11-entry cached-SE table. Exports with null slots dispatch: play_se +0xA8, play_se_no3d +0xB0, play_se_pos +0xB8, play_status_se +0xC0, play_sequence +0xD0, set_play_hit_se_flag +0xD8, set_no_hit_se +0xE8, set_continue_se_at_game_finish +0x188, stop_se_all +0x198, pause_se_all +0x1B8, set_gamespeed_se_calibration +0x2C0, set_remain_se +0x2D8. Slot layouts of the sound entries beyond the offsets cited are inferred from the constructor's store pattern.
